name: SPX JEV sequential-read additions (draft, not in the repo)
note: Question-set shape (spec/question_set.json). Every new question starts dark. SEQUENTIAL_READ marks questions whose label states two or more steps in time order and whose answer depends on that order.

new_constants.name: night_rank_count
new_constants.why: nights (or sessions/weekends) a same-clock rank looks back over (owner rule: rank against the last 20)

new_constants.name: btc_stale_min
new_constants.why: data-quality rule: oldest acceptable bitcoin print before the label is left out; value to set from the Coinbase feed's observed gaps

groups.purpose: Pre-market lane, 08:48 and 09:28 JEV reads (dark until the lane, collector and premarket grader exist): the night's story rebuilt from saved /ES bars at every read, four labels of at most 45 words each because every question in a group sees every label the group reads.

questions.ask: What has happened to the night's first real move since it was made?
questions.instructions: Read `premarket.where_now` and `premarket.arc`. Where futures are now against their 16:00 price decides first. Has the first leg that moved been built on, held, faded or reversed? Check in order: reversed, faded, built, held.

options.name: reversed
options.description: futures are now on the other side of their 16:00 price from the first move, by more than a quiet amount

options.name: faded
options.description: futures keep less than the half line of the first move

options.name: built
options.description: futures keep more than all of the first move: later trading pushed further the same way

options.name: held
options.description: futures keep between the half line and all of the first move

criteria.reversed: sign(net now) != sign(first moving leg) and |net now| rank > {third_lo} vs the same clock over the last {night_rank_count} nights

questions.sleep_when: no leg with |move| rank > {third_lo} (a quiet night), a roll night, or /ES bars missing

labels_needed.name: premarket.where_now
labels_needed.example: at 09:28 S&P futures are 0.31 sigma above their 16:00 price, higher than 16 of the last 20 nights at this time, top third; 85% of the way up the night's range
labels_needed.computed_how: /ES last finished 1-min close vs the same contract's 16:00 close, in yesterday's sigma_anchor; |move| ranked in thirds vs the same clock over the last {night_rank_count} nights (min {min_rank_sessions}; roll, holiday, estimated-ruler nights skipped); position in the high-low range since 16:00
labels_needed.source: state/spx_jev/overnight/{day}.jsonl (Schwab /ES extended-hours 1-min, as seen at the checkpoint, contract stamped)

labels_needed.name: premarket.arc
labels_needed.example: the first leg that moved was Asia, up 0.24 sigma; futures now keep 129% of it, still above their 16:00 price: later trading built on it
labels_needed.computed_how: first leg with |move| rank > {third_lo}; kept share = net now / that leg (stated as 'keep N%'); side of the 16:00 price now; net rank; verdict word by code
labels_needed.source: state/spx_jev/overnight/{day}.jsonl (Schwab /ES extended-hours 1-min, as seen at the checkpoint, contract stamped)

questions.why: Carries the night's sequence into a read with no memory: whether the first real move of the night was built on, held, faded or reversed is the shape a trader reads before the open.
questions.evidence: Untested as a JEV reading. Proposal 3 (130 nights, anchored on Asia): reversed nights (n=18) went against the Asia move 10:05-close; built nights (n=51) with it; first 30 min nothing. Anchoring on the first moving leg fixes the rule in Proposals 1-2 that fired 1 of 119 nights vs 16-19 real reversals (critique 1): the replay must confirm 'reversed' fires on about that many. Critique 1: shape repeats 47% of the overnight move bucket's information and did not beat it.

questions.ref_side: the night's net move before the leg

questions.ask: Across the lane's last reads, is the day's move from the open still making new ground, stalled, or unwinding?
questions.instructions: Read `seq.day_move_by_read`. Where price is now against the settled open decides first; the stage words decide the answer.

options.name: extending
options.description: this read set the day's furthest point from the open so far

options.name: stalled
options.description: the furthest point came at an earlier read and price has given back a small share of it for this time of day

options.name: unwinding
options.description: the furthest point came at an earlier read and price has given back a large share of it for this time of day

criteria.extending: furthest point from the 09:34 close is at this read
criteria.stalled: furthest point earlier; giveback share rank < {third_hi} vs the same clock over the last {night_rank_count} sessions
criteria.unwinding: furthest point earlier; giveback share rank >= {third_hi}

questions.sleep_when: |day move| within {move_rule_sigma}, fewer than two earlier reads today, or fewer than {min_rank_sessions} ranked sessions

labels_needed.name: seq.day_move_by_read
labels_needed.example: SPX is 0.27 sigma above the settled open; at the last four reads it stood 0.12 (10:02), 0.31 (10:32), 0.38 (11:02) and 0.27 (11:32) above; the furthest point came at 11:02 and 29% has been given back, top third for 11:32: unwinding
labels_needed.computed_how: (close at each earlier read minute - 09:34 close) / sigma_anchor, rebuilt from 1-min bars at the read minutes (not from saved records); last four reads; giveback ranked at the same clock

questions.why: A move that keeps making new ground read after read differs from one whose high came two reads ago; no single-window question says which read the extreme came at.
questions.evidence: Proposal 4 replay, 54 sessions: extending -> next 30 min with the day 38% / against 32% (n=168); stalled 32% / 41% (n=191); unwinding 35/35 (n=72). Weak, overlapping reads, one summer.

questions.ref_side: the day's move from the settled open
questions.dark_reason: waits on an offline replay on saved context bars ($UVOL, $DVOL)
questions.ask: Across the lane's last reads, has breadth built behind the day's move, faded under it, or tracked it?
questions.instructions: Read `seq.breadth_by_read`. Where price is now against the settled open decides first. Do not say which way price went. Check fading_under_move first.

options.name: fading_under_move
options.description: the volume share in rising stocks shifted away from the day's side more than usual while the move held or grew

options.name: building_behind_move
options.description: the share shifted toward the day's side more than usual

options.name: tracking
options.description: the share shifted about as usual

criteria.fading_under_move: change away from the day's side ranked >= {third_hi} vs the same stretch over the last {night_rank_count} sessions, and the day move did not shrink below its value at the first listed read
criteria.building_behind_move: change toward the day's side ranked >= {third_hi}

questions.sleep_when: |day move| within {move_rule_sigma}, fewer than two earlier reads today, or fewer than {min_rank_sessions} ranked sessions

labels_needed.name: seq.breadth_by_read
labels_needed.example: SPX is 0.36 sigma above the open; at 10:32, 11:02 and 11:32 it stood 0.20, 0.31 and 0.36 above while the day's rising-stock volume share was 71%, 64% and 58%: it slid 13 points while the move grew, top third over these minutes: fading under the move
labels_needed.computed_how: cumulative $UVOL/($UVOL+$DVOL) since 09:30 at each read minute; change over the listed reads signed to the day's side; ranked at the same clock

questions.why: breadth_day_regime judges one moment; a divergence is a sequence: price keeps going while the volume behind it slips read after read.
